audio_draft":[{"id":"ad_00","text":"稳了，稳了！","voice":"Ethan","mode":"dialogue","speaker":{"window_id":"window_9dde235fa882133e","role_id":"R_A"},"segment_ids":["seg_1"],"start_s":0.0,"end_s":1.2},{"id":"ad_01","text":"雪山脚下，它正忙着备粮过冬。","voice":"Moon","mode":"narration","segment_ids":["seg_1"],"start_s":1.2,"end_s":4.0},{"id":"ad_02","text":"一场漫长的等待结束了。","voice":"Moon","mode":"narration","segment_ids":["seg_2"],"start_s":4.0,"end_s":5.8},{"id":"ad_03","text":"它站了起来。","voice":"Moon","mode":"narration","segment_ids":["seg_2"],"start_s":5.8,"end_s":7.0},{"id":"ad_04","text":"你救过一只狐狸对吗？","voice":"Ethan","mode":"dialogue","speaker":{"window_id":"window_c6db9bac6f555ea8","role_id":"A"},"segment_ids":["seg_3"],"start_s":7.0,"end_s":9.0},{"id":"ad_05","text":"狐狸还是快递盒？","voice":"Ethan","mode":"dialogue","speaker":{"window_id":"window_c6db9bac6f555ea8","role_id":"A"},"segment_ids":["seg_3"],"start_s":9.0,"end_s":10.2},{"id":"ad_06","text":"都不是！","voice":"Serena","mode":"dialogue","speaker":{"window_id":"window_c6db9bac6f555ea8","role_id":"A"},"segment_ids":["seg_3"],"start_s":10.2,"end_s":11.0},{"id":"ad_07","text":"我是来自雪山的顺丰国际工作人员。","voice":"Serena","mode":"dialogue","speaker":{"window_id":"window_de89f1ab9c5f2cf7","role_id":"A"},"segment_ids":["seg_4","seg_5"],"start_s":11.0,"end_s":14.5},{"id":"ad_08","text":"跟我一起送快递去！","voice":"Serena","mode":"dialogue","speaker":{"window_id":"window_de89f1ab9c5f2cf7","role_id":"A"},"segment_ids":["seg_5"],"start_s":14.5,"end_s":16.0},{"id":"ad_09","text":"全世界多少客户在等着我们！","voice":"Serena","mode":"dialogue","speaker":{"window_id":"window_7a632a652f70d466","role_id":"A"},"segment_ids":["seg_6"],"start_s":16.0,"end_s":18.1},{"id":"ad_10","text":"来，跟我走！","voice":"Serena","mode":"dialogue","speaker":{"window_id":"window_7a632a652f70d466","role_id":"A"},"segment_ids":["seg_6"],"start_s":18.1,"end_s":19.0},{"id":"ad_11","text":"我是时效慢！","voice":"Serena","mode":"dialogue","speaker":{"window_id":"window_2099126c6e384863","role_id":"B"},"segment_ids":["seg_7"],"start_s":19.0,"end_s":20.0},{"id":"ad_12","text":"我是卡清关！","voice":"Ethan","mode":"dialogue","speaker":{"window_id":"window_7a067b2acd1d7f47","role_id":"B"},"segment_ids":["seg_8"],"start_s":20.0,"end_s":21.5},{"id":"ad_13","text":"我是追踪难！","voice":"Ethan","mode":"dialogue","speaker":{"window_id":"window_7a067b2acd1d7f47","role_id":"B"},"segment_ids":["seg_8"],"start_s":21.5,"end_s":23.0},{"id":"ad_14","text":"三大痛点，逐个击破！","voice":"Moon","mode":"narration","segment_ids":["seg_8"],"start_s":23.0,"end_s":25.5},{"id":"ad_15","text":"时效慢被击倒。","voice":"Moon","mode":"narration","segment_ids":["seg_9"],"start_s":28.0,"end_s":30.0},{"id":"ad_16","text":"清关卡被解决。","voice":"Moon","mode":"narration","segment_ids":["seg_9"],"start_s":30.0,"end_s":32.0},{"id":"ad_17","text":"追踪难也被消灭。","voice":"Moon","mode":"narration","segment_ids":["seg_9"],"start_s":32.0,"end_s":34.3},{"id":"ad_18","text":"我们有顺丰国际兜底！","voice":"Ethan","mode":"dialogue","speaker":{"window_id":"window_5b062e4ed5280f25","role_id":"A"},"segment_ids":["seg_10"],"start_s":34.5,"end_s":36.5},{"id":"ad_19","text":"顺丰国际全球达。","voice":"Serena","mode":"dialogue","speaker":{"window_id":"window_8aa46a19469d88ae","role_id":"R_A"},"segment_ids":["seg_10","seg_11"],"start_s":36.6,"end_s":37.0},{"id":"ad_20","text":"您的跨境包裹，有我们守护。","voice":"Ethan","mode":"dialogue","speaker":{"window_id":"window_8aa46a19469d88ae","role_id":"R_A"},"segment_ids":["seg_11"],"start_s":37.0,"end_s":39.0}],"audio_relation":[{"segment_id":"seg_1","relation":"narration"},{"segment_id":"seg_2","relation":"narration"},{"segment_id":"seg_3","relation":"on_screen"},{"segment_id":"seg_4","relation":"on_screen"},{"segment_id":"seg_5","relation":"on_screen"},{"segment_id":"seg_6","relation":"on_screen"},{"segment_id":"seg_7","relation":"reaction"},{"segment_id":"seg_8","relation":"on_screen"},{"segment_id":"seg_9","relation":"narration"},{"segment_id":"seg_10","relation":"on_screen"},{"segment_id":"seg_11","relation":"on_screen"}],"reference_audio":null,"wi
